-        raise NotImplementedError("between-round residual update is not implemented")
+        if self.cjt.is_factorised():

 import copy

-from .executor import PandasExecutor, SPJAData, ExecuteMode
+from .executor import PandasExecutor, DuckdbExecutor, DataFrameExecutor, SparkExecutor, SPJAData, ExecuteMode
 from .aggregator import *
 
 
+class _Side:
+    """One branch of a snowflake join graph rooted at the fact table: a neighbour
+    of the fact table together with every relation reachable from it without
+    passing through the fact table.
+
+    Every join on the way out of the fact table is many-to-one, so the branch's
+    features are a function of the fact table's join key with the neighbour.
+    They are denormalised into one small side table holding one row per key
+    value present in the fact table (never a fact-scale relation)."""
+
+    def __init__(self, neighbour, keys, neighbour_keys, relations):
+        self.neighbour = neighbour
+        # join columns of the fact table; also the key columns of the side table
+        self.keys = keys
+        self.neighbour_keys = neighbour_keys
+        # relations of the branch, in DFS order from the neighbour
+        self.relations = relations
+        # (relation, feature) -> column of the side table
+        self.columns = {}
+        self.table = None
+
+    def column(self, relation, attr):
+        return self.columns[(relation, value_to_sql(attr, qualified=False))]
+
+    def predicate(self, relation, annotation):
+        """SQL of an annotation of `relation`, evaluated over the side table."""
+        if annotation.selection in (SELECTION.NULL, SELECTION.NOT_NULL):
+            para = self.column(relation, annotation.para)
+        else:
+            para = (self.column(relation, annotation.para[0]),) + tuple(annotation.para[1:])
+        return "(" + selection_to_sql(SelectionExpression(annotation.selection, para), qualified=False) + ")"
+
+    def on(self, left, right):
+        return " AND ".join(f"{left}.{k} = {right}.{k}" for k in self.keys)
+
+    def key_list(self, alias):
+        return ", ".join(f"{alias}.{k}" for k in self.keys)
+
+
+class _Split:
+    """Shared state of one split; both children are derived from it lazily."""
+
+    def __init__(self, parent):
+        self.parent = parent
+        self.side = None
+        self.left = None
+        self.right = None
+        # SQL predicates (over the side table) of the left and right child
+        self.preds = [None, None]
+        # side neighbour -> table (keys, features, sl, cl, sr, cr) holding both
+        # children's messages towards a branch other than the split's
+        self.sources = {}
+
+
+class _Source:
+    """A node's message towards a branch: a table with the branch's key and
+    feature columns and per-key residual sums, restricted to the node's keys by
+    the predicates in `applied` plus the node's remaining branch predicates."""
+
+    def __init__(self, table, g, h, applied, counted):
+        self.table = table
+        self.g = g
+        self.h = h
+        self.applied = applied
+        # whether every key of the table holds at least one of the node's rows
+        self.counted = counted
+
+
+class _Factorised:
+    """Fit-wide state of the factorised training representation.
+
+    The residuals live in one slim fact table (gradient column plus the fact
+    table's join keys). A node's message towards a branch holds its residual sums
+    per branch key next to the branch's features, so every split statistic is a
+    small aggregation over it. A split on a branch only filters the messages
+    towards that branch; one aggregation over the fact table gives the smaller
+    child's messages towards the other branches, and the sibling's follow by
+    subtraction from the parent's."""
+
+    def __init__(self, cjt):
+        self.exe = cjt.exe
+        self.fact = cjt.target_relation
+        self.g_col, self.h_col = cjt.semi_ring.get_columns_name()
+        self.sides = []
+        self.side_of = {}
+        for neighbour in cjt.joins[self.fact]:
+            keys, neighbour_keys = cjt.joins[self.fact][neighbour]["keys"]
+            relations = []
+
+            def dfs(relation, parent):
+                relations.append(relation)
+                for child in cjt.joins[relation]:
+                    if child != parent:
+                        dfs(child, relation)
+
+            dfs(neighbour, self.fact)
+            side = _Side(neighbour, list(keys), list(neighbour_keys), relations)
+            for relation in relations:
+                self.side_of[relation] = side
+                for attr in cjt.relations[relation]:
+                    side.columns[(relation, attr)] = f"jb_f{len(side.columns)}"
+            self.sides.append(side)
+        self.root = None
+        self.views = set()
+        # tables holding the current tree's state, dropped once the tree is built
+        self.tree_tables = []
+        # tables of the finished tree still needed by the next one
+        self.carried = []
+        self.root_sources = {}
+        # branch -> (previous root message table, per-key prediction of the
+        # previous tree) when that tree only split this branch
+        self.derived = {}
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def supports(cjt):
+        if not isinstance(cjt.exe, DuckdbExecutor) or isinstance(cjt.exe, (DataFrameExecutor, SparkExecutor)):
+            return False
+        if cjt.target_relation not in cjt.joins:
+            return False
+        if cjt.relations[cjt.target_relation]:
+            return False
+        g_col, h_col = cjt.semi_ring.get_columns_name()
+        keys = [k for n in cjt.joins[cjt.target_relation] for k in cjt.joins[cjt.target_relation][n]["keys"][0]]
+        return len(set(keys)) == len(keys) and not {g_col, h_col} & set(keys)
+
+    def run(self, statements):
+        if statements:
+            self.exe._execute_query(";\n".join(statements))
+
+    def new_name(self, tree=True):
+        name = self.exe.get_next_name()
+        if tree:
+            self.tree_tables.append(name)
+        return name
+
+    def side_table_sql(self, cjt, side, keys_table):
+        """Denormalise a branch, restricted to the keys present in the fact table."""
+        alias = {relation: f"t{i}" for i, relation in enumerate(side.relations)}
+        from_sql = f"{keys_table} m JOIN {side.neighbour} t0 ON " + " AND ".join(
+            f"m.{k} = t0.{nk}" for k, nk in zip(side.keys, side.neighbour_keys))
+        for relation in side.relations[1:]:
+            parent = next(p for p in cjt.joins[relation]
+                          if p in alias and side.relations.index(p) < side.relations.index(relation))
+            p_keys, c_keys = cjt.joins[parent][relation]["keys"]
+            from_sql += f" JOIN {relation} {alias[relation]} ON " + " AND ".join(
+                f"{alias[parent]}.{pk} = {alias[relation]}.{ck}" for pk, ck in zip(p_keys, c_keys))
+        columns = [f"m.{k} AS {k}" for k in side.keys] + [
+            f"{alias[relation]}.{attr} AS {column}" for (relation, attr), column in side.columns.items()]
+        side.table = self.new_name(tree=False)
+        return f"CREATE TABLE {side.table} AS SELECT {', '.join(columns)} FROM {from_sql}"
+
+    def features(self, side, alias):
+        return "".join(f", {alias}.{c}" for c in side.columns.values())
+

+        fz = self._fz
+        self._split_rec = None
+        fz.root_sources = {}
+        statements = []
+        derived, fz.derived = fz.derived, {}
+        for side in fz.sides:
+            keys = ", ".join(side.keys)
+            if side.neighbour in derived:
+                # the previous tree only split this branch: its prediction is a function
+                # of the branch key, so the residual sums per key follow from the previous ones
+                previous, prediction = derived[side.neighbour]
+                name = fz.new_name()
+                fz.root_sources[side.neighbour] = _Source(name, fz.g_col, fz.h_col, [], True)
+                g, h = fz.g_col, fz.h_col
+                statements.append(
+                    f"CREATE TABLE {name} AS SELECT {side.key_list('m')}{fz.features(side, 'm')}, "
+                    f"m.{g} - ({prediction}) * m.{h} AS {g}, m.{h} FROM {previous} m")
+                continue
+            messages = (f"(SELECT {keys}, SUM({fz.g_col}) AS {fz.g_col}, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS {fz.h_col} "
+                        f"FROM {fz.root} GROUP BY {keys})")
+            if side.table is None:
+                # first tree: the root's messages also enumerate the branch keys of the fact table
+                messages = fz.new_name()
+                statements.append(f"CREATE TABLE {messages} AS SELECT {keys}, SUM({fz.g_col}) AS {fz.g_col}, "
+                                  f"COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS {fz.h_col} FROM {fz.root} GROUP BY {keys}")
+                statements.append(fz.side_table_sql(self, side, messages))
+            name = fz.new_name()
+            fz.root_sources[side.neighbour] = _Source(name, fz.g_col, fz.h_col, [], True)
+            statements.append(
+                f"CREATE TABLE {name} AS SELECT {side.key_list('d')}{fz.features(side, 'd')}, m.{fz.g_col}, m.{fz.h_col} "
+                f"FROM {messages} m JOIN {side.table} d ON {side.on('m', 'd')}")
+        fz.run(statements)
+
+    def _fz_selection(self, side):
+        """SQL predicates (over the side table) selecting this node's keys of a branch.
+        A node's annotations are complete before its statistics are first needed."""
+        selection = self._selections.get(side.neighbour)
+        if selection is None:
+            selection = [side.predicate(relation, annotation)
+                         for relation in side.relations for annotation in self.annotations.get(relation, [])]
+            self._selections[side.neighbour] = selection
+        return selection
+
+    def _fz_source(self, side):
+        """This node's message towards a branch (a _Source)."""
+        split = self._split
+        if split is None:
+            return self._fz.root_sources[side.neighbour]
+        if split.side is side:
+            return split.parent._fz_source(side)
+        if side.neighbour not in split.sources:
+            self._fz_split_sources(split)
+        table, applied = split.sources[side.neighbour]
+        return _Source(table, "sl" if self._left else "sr", "cl" if self._left else "cr", applied, False)
+
+    def _fz_split_sources(self, split):
+        """Both children's messages towards every branch other than the split's:
+        the smaller child's by one aggregation over the fact table, the sibling's
+        by subtraction from the parent's."""
+        fz = self._fz
+        parent, side = split.parent, split.side
+        small = 0 if split.left.semi_ring.get_value()[1] <= split.right.semi_ring.get_value()[1] else 1
+        where = parent._fz_selection(side) + [split.preds[small]]
+        filters = (f" JOIN (SELECT {', '.join(side.keys)} FROM {side.table} WHERE {' AND '.join(where)}) f "
+                   f"ON {side.on('r', 'f')}")
+        statements = []
+        for target in fz.sides:
+            if target is side or target.neighbour in split.sources:
+                continue
+            joins = filters
+            for i, other in enumerate(fz.sides):
+                selection = parent._fz_selection(other)
+                if other is side or other is target or not selection:
+                    continue
+                joins += (f" JOIN (SELECT {', '.join(other.keys)} FROM {other.table} WHERE "
+                          f"{' AND '.join(selection)}) w{i} ON {other.on('r', f'w{i}')}")
+            source = parent._fz_source(target)
+            selection = parent._fz_selection(target)
+            remaining = [p for p in selection if p not in source.applied]
+            g, h = fz.g_col, fz.h_col
+            direct = [f"COALESCE(t.{g}, 0)", f"COALESCE(t.{h}, 0)"]
+            rest = [f"m.{source.g} - COALESCE(t.{g}, 0)", f"m.{source.h} - COALESCE(t.{h}, 0)"]
+            sl, cl, sr, cr = direct + rest if small == 0 else rest + direct
+            aggregate = (f"SELECT {target.key_list('r')}, SUM(r.{g}) AS {g}, COUNT(*)::DOUBLE AS {h} "
+                         f"FROM {fz.root} r{joins} GROUP BY {target.key_list('r')}")
+            name = fz.new_name()
+            split.sources[target.neighbour] = (name, selection)
+            statements.append(
+                f"CREATE TABLE {name} AS SELECT {target.key_list('m')}{fz.features(target, 'm')}, "
+                f"{sl} AS sl, {cl} AS cl, {sr} AS sr, {cr} AS cr FROM {source.table} m LEFT JOIN "
+                f"({aggregate}) t ON {target.on('m', 't')}"
+                + (f" WHERE {' AND '.join(remaining)}" if remaining else ""))
+        fz.run(statements)
+
+    def _fz_absorption(self, side, column, attr):
+        fz = self._fz
+        source = self._fz_source(side)
+        remaining = [p for p in self._fz_selection(side) if p not in source.applied]
+        return (f"(SELECT SUM({source.g}) AS {fz.g_col}, SUM({source.h}) AS {fz.h_col}, {column} AS {attr} "
+                f"FROM {source.table}" + (f" WHERE {' AND '.join(remaining)}" if remaining else "")
+                + f" GROUP BY {column}" + ("" if source.counted else f" HAVING SUM({source.h}) > 0") + ")")
+
+    def update_residuals(self, leaf_nodes, learning_rate):
+        """Subtract the finished tree's leaf predictions from the residuals of the
+        fact table; the new residual table becomes this (root) CJT's target."""
+        fz = self._fz
+        if self._split_rec is None:
+            return
+        preds = {}
+        for leaf in leaf_nodes:
+            g, h = leaf.get_semi_ring().get_value()
+            preds[leaf] = float(g / h) * learning_rate
+
+        # splits of the tree, grouped by branch
+        splits = {}
+
+        def collect(node):
+            split = node._split_rec
+            if split is not None:
+                splits.setdefault(split.side.neighbour, []).append(split)
+                collect(split.left)
+                collect(split.right)
+
+        collect(self)
+        used = [side for side in fz.sides if side.neighbour in splits]
+
+        def evaluate(node, test):
+            split = node._split_rec
+            if split is None:
+                return f"'{preds[node]!r}'::DOUBLE"
+            left, right = test(split)
+            return (f"CASE WHEN {left} THEN {evaluate(split.left, test)} "
+                    f"WHEN {right} THEN {evaluate(split.right, test)} ELSE 0 END")
+
+        g = fz.g_col
+        if len(used) == 1:
+            # the tree only splits one branch: its prediction is a function of that branch's key
+            side = used[0]
+            prediction = evaluate(self, lambda split: split.preds)
+            joins = (f" JOIN (SELECT {', '.join(side.keys)}, {prediction} AS jb_p "
+                     f"FROM {side.table}) d ON {side.on('r', 'd')}")
+            value = "d.jb_p"
+            previous = fz.root_sources[side.neighbour].table
+            fz.derived[side.neighbour] = (previous, prediction)
+            fz.tree_tables.remove(previous)
+            fz.carried.append(previous)
+        else:
+            # direction bits of every split (left, right), 30 splits per BIGINT mask
+            bit = {}
+            joins = ""
+            for j, side in enumerate(used):
+                columns = []
+                for c in range(0, len(splits[side.neighbour]), 30):
+                    terms = []
+                    for i, split in enumerate(splits[side.neighbour][c:c + 30]):
+                        bit[split] = (f"d{j}.m{c // 30}", 1 << (2 * i))
+                        terms.append(f"CASE WHEN {split.preds[0]} THEN {1 << (2 * i)} ELSE 0 END")
+                        terms.append(f"CASE WHEN {split.preds[1]} THEN {1 << (2 * i + 1)} ELSE 0 END")
+                    columns.append(f"CAST({' + '.join(terms)} AS BIGINT) AS m{c // 30}")
+                joins += (f" JOIN (SELECT {', '.join(side.keys)}, {', '.join(columns)} FROM {side.table}) d{j} "
+                          f"ON {side.on('r', f'd{j}')}")
+
+            def test(split):
+                mask, b = bit[split]
+                return f"({mask} & {b}) <> 0", f"({mask} & {2 * b}) <> 0"
+
+            value = f"({evaluate(self, test)})"
+        keys = ", ".join(f"r.{k}" for side in fz.sides for k in side.keys)
+        name = fz.new_name(tree=False)
+        fz.run([f"CREATE TABLE {name} AS SELECT r.{g} - {value} AS {g}, {keys} FROM {fz.root} r{joins}"])
+        fz.tree_tables.append(fz.root)
+        self.replace(fz.root, name)
+        fz.root = name
